summary: Task 3 (Payroll salary+incentive) + WhatsApp contact + Bank label — full end-to-end verification. Backend pytest 18/18 passing (payroll SET auth, payroll VIEW math for target-met and target-unmet paths, run_payroll_for_week idempotency w/ SALARY txn count exactly 1, WhatsApp set/get on ADMIN & MANAGER + player-side surfaces on /wallet/my-agent & /wallet/deposit-info, null whatsapp graceful, PLAYER forbidden 403, bank account label create+list). Frontend: Super Admin Managers panel Pay button + modal (payroll-manager-{id} / payroll-salary-input/target-input/pct-input/submit); Zonal Managers panel Pay button + modal (payroll-zonal-{id} / payroll-zonal-salary/target/pct/submit) with actual save round-trip; Manager console shows payroll-card (₹5,000 salary / ₹426 incentive / ₹5,426 total + progress bar) driven by /admin/my-payroll (downline revenue ₹4,260 × 10%); Zonal console shows payroll-card via /admin/zonal/my-payroll (₹8,000 total, target not met); Admin Bank Account tab shows whatsapp-card with whatsapp-input+whatsapp-save that persists, and bank-add modal exposes bank-label field; Player Add-Coins shows deposit-whatsapp-btn with correct https://wa.me/919876543210?text=Hi%2C%20I%20need%20help%20with%20my%20payment href; new-player registration shows welcome-agent-modal identifying assigned admin, gracefully renders 'no WhatsApp yet' note when admin has none, and DOES NOT reappear on page reload (r11_welcome flag cleared).
critical_code_review_comments: payroll_service._compute uses round(revenue * pct / 100) with pct as float — banker's rounding could differ by ₹1 vs frontend if UI ever recomputes; UI correctly reads projected_incentive_inr from backend so no drift observed.

payroll_service.run_recent_payroll pays LAST week only; if the daily scheduler ever misses >1 week the missed week is silently skipped. Consider a small catch-up loop over unpaid weeks (idempotency guarantees safety).
set_payroll uses collection-name string 'manager'/'zonal' as an implicit switch; a typo would silently target manager_allocations. A Literal[str] param or enum would harden this.
payroll_view.history uses simple limit(12) without pagination; fine for weekly cadence but should be labeled as 'recent 12' in UI (currently is).

Admin.list_managers returns weekly_salary_inr/incentive_target_inr/incentive_pct alongside quota fields — good; ZM list should mirror this for consistency in ZonalManagersPanel (currently reads from row and works, but a fresh listing after payroll save requires an explicit refresh which the modal does).

deposit_service.set_whatsapp_number stores whatsapp with no format validation (no digits-only strip / country code check). Frontend link builder uses only digits, so bad input silently produces broken wa.me link. Consider server-side normalization to digits.

Welcome modal flag (localStorage 'r11_welcome') is per-browser; if user registers, closes the tab immediately, and opens on a new device, they will see it again. Acceptable for a welcome nudge but noted.
